title: End Semester Examination Schedule & Venue Relocation
description: Official scheduling, reporting times, and hall assignments for Undergraduate and Postgraduate Fall examinations.

versions.changesSummary: Initial publication of Fall 2026 examination schedule.
versions.content:
NOTIFICATION NO. CCU/EXAM/2026/089

All registered students are hereby notified that the End Semester Examinations for Fall 2026 will commence on Monday, October 12, 2026.

Examination Details:
- Reporting Time: 08:30 AM
- Examination Timing: 09:00 AM – 12:00 PM
- Primary Examination Venue: Hall 302, Main Academic Block
- Allowed Materials: Standard non-programmable calculator, black/blue pen, University Student ID Card.

Students without valid physical identity cards will not be permitted entry. Please verify hall seating charts posted outside Hall 302 on the morning of the exam.
versions.signatory: Dr. Aris Thorne, Controller of Examinations

versions.changesSummary: Rescheduled examination date from Oct 12 to Oct 15 and relocated venue from Hall 302 to Hall 408 (Annex Wing) due to electrical maintenance in Main Academic Block.
versions.content:
ADDENDUM / REVISED NOTIFICATION NO. CCU/EXAM/2026/089-R2

ATTENTION ALL STUDENTS: Due to unscheduled emergency electrical infrastructure upgrades in the Main Academic Block, the examination schedule published on Oct 01 has been officially revised.

Revised Examination Details:
- Revised Date: Thursday, October 15, 2026 (Postponed from Oct 12)
- Reporting Time: 10:00 AM
- Examination Timing: 10:30 AM – 01:30 PM
- Relocated Venue: Hall 408, Science & Technology Annex Wing (2nd Floor)

Students must report to Hall 408. Notice posted in Hall 302 is no longer valid. Seating allocations remain identical to the published roll-number registry.
versions.signatory: Dr. Aris Thorne, Controller of Examinations

title: Central Library Extended Reading Room Hours
description: Operational hours, quiet study zones, and digital archive access during the examination preparation period.

versions.content:
CIRCULAR NO. LIB/2026/14

The Central Library announces standard operational hours for the Fall Academic Semester:

- Monday through Friday: 08:00 AM – 08:00 PM
- Saturdays & Sundays: CLOSED
- Book Circulation Desk: Closes at 07:00 PM daily
- Digital Archive Terminals: Available during building hours

Quiet zones strictly enforced on Floors 2 and 3. Food and open beverages are prohibited.
versions.signatory: Prof. Elena Vance, Chief University Librarian

versions.changesSummary: Extended weekday evening closing by 3 hours (until 11:00 PM) and opened weekend study access to support upcoming exams.
versions.content:
NOTIFICATION NO. LIB/2026/14-EXT

In response to student requests ahead of End Semester Examinations, the Central Library will operate on extended hours effective Monday, October 05, 2026 through the end of exam week.

Revised Operational Hours:
- Monday through Friday: 07:00 AM – 11:00 PM (Extended by 3 hours)
- Saturdays & Sundays: 09:00 AM – 05:00 PM (Weekend Access Now Open)
- 24/7 Overnight Reading Room: Ground Floor Annex available with University ID scan

Circulation desks close at 08:30 PM. Overnight access requires active biometric or smartcard badge verification.
versions.signatory: Prof. Elena Vance, Chief University Librarian

title: Annual Student Identity Card Validation & Campus Pass Renewal
description: Mandatory smartcard re-validation, gate biometric sync, and library barcode activation for all continuing students.

versions.changesSummary: Official notice for Annual Student ID Card Validation and security pass update for Academic Year 2026-27.
versions.content:
REGISTRAR DIRECTIVE NO. REG/ID/2026-44

All continuing Undergraduate and Postgraduate students must renew their physical Student Identity Cards between November 01 and November 20, 2026.

Renewal Procedures:
1. Verify clearance of semester tuition balance via the Student Finance portal.
2. Present existing physical ID card at Counter 4, Registrar's Hall, Administrative Wing.
3. Operational Window: 09:30 AM – 04:00 PM on official university working days.

Unvalidated ID cards will be deactivated at turnstile gates and library RFID readers starting November 25, 2026. Replacement for physically lost or mutilated cards requires Form ID-9 with administrative fee.
versions.signatory: Marcus Sterling, Registrar & Secretary to Academic Council
